image_description: Two American bison standing in a grassy field with trees in the background. The bison on the left is facing forward-left, displaying its head, horns, and shoulder hump. The bison on the right is facing left, showing its profile, heavy forequarters, and hind legs.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beard of long hair on chin and throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The bison on the left clearly shows the shaggy beard hanging from the chin and throat area.
Eyes are visible on the left bison and appear dark, consistent with the species.
Ears are not prominently sticking out; they are small and nestled within the thick head fur, matching the description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Shaggy dark brown fur covering forequarters forming prominent shoulder hump.
